weapons.name: Wooden Training Sword
weapons.description: Starter practice blade carved from Rowan oak; lightweight, agile, and easy to swing in basic caverns.
weapons.upgrade_path: Upgrades at Boris's Forge: Oak Wood → Copper Bar
weapons.special_effect: Introductory weapon to master the 3-strike attack cadence across upper cavern shafts.
weapons.runic_skill: Pommel Strike: Staggers small pests for 0.5s with a quick blunt pommel hit.
weapons.materials_needed: 15 Oak Wood + 100 Gold at Boris's Forge

weapons.name: Copper Broadsword
weapons.description: Oil-tempered red copper broadsword; robust edge that cleaves through cavern brambles and clinging cave vines.
weapons.upgrade_path: Upgrades at Boris's Forge: Copper → Iron
weapons.special_effect: Cleaves thorny vines blocking tunnels and disperses scarab nests quickly.
weapons.runic_skill: Whirlwind Slash: Sweeps 360 degrees to knock back swarming enemies.
weapons.materials_needed: 6 Copper Bars + 2 Coal + 600 Gold at Boris's Forge

weapons.name: Oakhaven Forged Steelblade
weapons.description: Forged from deep cavern iron and quenched in subterranean mineral springs; 3rd strike staggers defensive monsters.
weapons.upgrade_path: Upgrades at Boris's Forge: Iron → Gold
weapons.special_effect: 3rd strike cracks monster defensive stances and shatters minor surrounding rocks.
weapons.runic_skill: Parry & Counter: Perfect parry stuns target for 2s and reflects 150% incoming damage.
weapons.materials_needed: 8 Iron Bars + 4 Coal + 1,800 Gold at Boris's Forge

weapons.name: Sunburst Rapier
weapons.description: Gilded rapier radiating solar heat; stores thermal kinetic force that gently burns struck targets.
weapons.upgrade_path: Upgrades at Boris's Forge: Gold → Obsidian
weapons.special_effect: Ultra-fast thrusts ignite targets with stacking burn damage over time.
weapons.runic_skill: Solar Thrust: Dashes through enemies leaving a searing trail of light.
weapons.materials_needed: 6 Gold Bars + 1 Ruby + 4,500 Gold at Boris's Forge

weapons.name: Obsidian Flame Saber
weapons.description: Forged from razor-sharp volcanic glass and iron; strikes release bursts of magma flame searing targets for 4s.
weapons.upgrade_path: Upgrades at Boris's Forge: Obsidian → Starlight Core
weapons.special_effect: Slices through molten rock armor; inflicts +25% bonus damage against frost creatures.
weapons.runic_skill: Magma Eruption: Plunges blade into ground to erupt a volcanic geyser.
weapons.materials_needed: 10 Obsidian + 5 Iron Bars + 9,000 Gold at Boris's Forge

weapons.name: Starlight Blade
weapons.description: Luminescent crystal blade with a fluid 3-hit rhythm, leaving a trail of shimmering stardust. The third strike shatters hard rocks and pierces void armor.
weapons.upgrade_path: Pinnacle Tier: Forged at Boris's Forge with a Starlight Core
weapons.special_effect: 3rd strike releases a starlight wave that shatters hard rocks and pierces void armor.
weapons.runic_skill: Astral Cascade: Releases 5 homing starlight blade shards.
weapons.materials_needed: 1 Starlight Core + 4 Diamonds + 20,000 Gold at Boris's Forge

weapons.name: Rusty Farm Scythe
weapons.description: Rowan's heirloom farming tool; weathered edge that cuts thick weeds and reaps wheat across 3 tiles at once.
weapons.upgrade_path: Upgrades at Boris's Forge: Farm Scythe → Mystic Scythe
weapons.special_effect: Rapidly reaps crops and herbs; drives away minor cave pests and garden vermin.
weapons.runic_skill: Wide Sweep: Reaping sweep that knocks back all low-tier monsters.
weapons.materials_needed: 10 Oak Wood + 5 Stone + 150 Gold at Boris's Forge

weapons.name: Mystic Scythe
weapons.description: Enchanted scythe with a wide semi-circular sweep — dual-purposed for controlling swarms of pests and reaping patches of wheat and herbs in one swing.
weapons.upgrade_path: Upgrades at Boris's Forge: Iron → Silver
weapons.special_effect: Sweeps small swarms & reaps wide farming plots in a single arc.
weapons.runic_skill: Harvest Vortex: Twirls scythe into a localized cyclone that pulls monsters together.
weapons.materials_needed: 6 Copper Bars + 4 Iron Bars + 1 Emerald + 2,400 Gold at Boris's Forge

weapons.name: Silver Moon Scythe
weapons.description: Silver lunar blade glowing with cool moonbeams; razor-sharp sweep that siphons Stamina whenever clearing enemy packs.
weapons.upgrade_path: Upgrades at Boris's Forge: Silver → Starlight Core
weapons.special_effect: Restores 3 Stamina for every monster slain in its crescent sweep.
weapons.runic_skill: Crescent Moon Wave: Projects a glowing lunar crescent wave through all enemies.
weapons.materials_needed: 8 Silver Bars + 2 Amethysts + 6,000 Gold at Boris's Forge

weapons.name: Astral Void Reaper
weapons.description: Mythic scythe cleaving the fabric of space; opens astral rifts that devour the vitality of shadow monsters.
weapons.upgrade_path: Pinnacle Tier: Forged at Boris's Forge with a Starlight Core
weapons.special_effect: Cleaves spatial fabric; grants +30% bonus rare loot drop rate on slain monsters.
weapons.runic_skill: Soul Severance: Instantly executes regular monsters below 25% health.
weapons.materials_needed: 1 Starlight Core + 8 Obsidian + 2 Diamonds + 22,000 Gold at Boris's Forge

weapons.name: Miner's Stone Mallet
weapons.description: Dense river stone block bound to an oak handle; pulverizes rubble and coal veins without consuming pickaxe stamina.
weapons.upgrade_path: Upgrades at Boris's Forge: Stone → Spiked Copper Mace
weapons.special_effect: Crushes coal veins and rocks; heavy swings interrupt monster attack windups.
weapons.runic_skill: Heavy Stomp: Slams the floor to stagger all nearby subterranean critters for 1s.
weapons.materials_needed: 20 Stone + 5 Oak Wood + 200 Gold at Boris's Forge

weapons.name: Copper Spiked Mace
weapons.description: Heavy bronze mace studded with sharp spikes; cracks the tough chitin of cavern scarabs and magma magnesnails.
weapons.upgrade_path: Upgrades at Boris's Forge: Copper → Iron
weapons.special_effect: Bronze spikes shatter defense; breaks copper ore deposits in just a couple swings.
weapons.runic_skill: Armor Shatter: Crushing swing reduces target defense by 40% for 5s.
weapons.materials_needed: 8 Copper Bars + 4 Coal + 850 Gold at Boris's Forge

weapons.name: Colossal Tea Whisk Hammer
weapons.description: Heavy blunt warhammer that slams the ground to unleash shockwaves — pulverizing armored stone golems and mineral deposits simultaneously.
weapons.upgrade_path: Upgrades at Boris's Forge: Iron → Obsidian
weapons.special_effect: Slam shatters monster armor and mineral nodes simultaneously.
weapons.runic_skill: Matcha Shockwave: Slams ground emitting powdered matcha ripples that slow foes by 50%.
weapons.materials_needed: 10 Iron Bars + 2 Crystal Gems + 2,500 Gold at Boris's Forge

weapons.name: Magma Crag Warhammer
weapons.description: Colossal warhammer cast from molten obsidian; impact generates explosive concussive booms and searing thermal waves.
weapons.upgrade_path: Upgrades at Boris's Forge: Obsidian → Starlight Core
weapons.special_effect: Crushes massive obsidian boulders in one blow; grants burn immunity while wielded.
weapons.runic_skill: Fissure Slam: Slams hammer creating a 4-tile magma fissure erupting beneath enemies.
weapons.materials_needed: 12 Obsidian + 6 Iron Bars + 10,500 Gold at Boris's Forge

weapons.name: Titan Stellar Crusher
weapons.description: The ultimate blunt weapon taught by Boris — carries the mass of a miniature fallen meteor, crushing everything in its trajectory.
weapons.upgrade_path: Pinnacle Tier: Forged at Boris's Forge with a Starlight Core
weapons.special_effect: Colossal single-hit crushing power; knocks back all foes and obliterates hardest obstacles.
weapons.runic_skill: Meteor Impact: Leaps into the air and crashes down like a falling celestial meteor.
weapons.materials_needed: 1 Starlight Core + 4 Diamonds + 10 Gold Bars + 25,000 Gold at Boris's Forge

weapons.name: Oakhaven Hunter Bow
weapons.description: Nimble shortbow bent from flexible oak boughs and wild vine twine; ideal for hunting game and baiting cave beasts from afar.
weapons.upgrade_path: Upgrades at Boris's Forge: Oak Wood → Clockwork Crossbow
weapons.special_effect: Fires scout arrows into dark corners; checks monster reactions from safe distance.
weapons.runic_skill: Aimed Shot: Full tension release delivering 200% critical damage.
weapons.materials_needed: 15 Oak Wood + 5 Forest Vines + 180 Gold at Boris's Forge

weapons.name: Clockwork Iron Crossbow
weapons.description: Ancient Dwarven cog mechanism automatically winds and reloads; high-penetration bolts pierce through the first enemy in flight.
weapons.upgrade_path: Upgrades at Boris's Forge: Iron → Gold
weapons.special_effect: Internal cogs auto-cock bolts; shots pierce through the first monster struck.
weapons.runic_skill: Triple Burst: Rapidly discharges 3 high-velocity steel bolts in an instant.
weapons.materials_needed: 8 Iron Bars + 2 Dwarven Cogs + 2,800 Gold at Boris's Forge

weapons.name: Golden Solar Arbalest
weapons.description: Intricately gilded sniper arbalest with crystal optics; fires dazzling radiant bolts that blind nocturnal cave creatures for 3s.
weapons.upgrade_path: Upgrades at Boris's Forge: Gold → Starlight Core
weapons.special_effect: Dazzling light bolts blind nocturnal cave beasts for 3s upon impact.
weapons.runic_skill: Sunbeam Piercer: Fires a high-intensity radiant spear piercing all monsters in line.
weapons.materials_needed: 10 Gold Bars + 2 Topaz + 6,500 Gold at Boris's Forge

weapons.name: Starblight Void Repeater
weapons.description: Pinnacle ranged weapon requiring no mundane ammo; condenses void stardust into barrages of self-propelling explosive bolts.
weapons.upgrade_path: Pinnacle Tier: Forged at Boris's Forge with a Starlight Core
weapons.special_effect: Consumes no mundane bolts; manifests stardust shards that explode on impact.
weapons.runic_skill: Starlight Barrage: Calls down a celestial rain of star arrows across a 4x4 tile area.
weapons.materials_needed: 1 Starlight Core + 6 Silver Bars + 3 Diamonds + 24,000 Gold at Boris's Forge

weapons.name: Apprentice Oak Wand
weapons.description: Simple wand turned from sacred oak sprigs tipped with chipped quartz; fires gentle pollen sparks illuminating dark corridors.
weapons.upgrade_path: Upgrades at Boris's Forge: Oak Wand → Firefly Lantern
weapons.special_effect: Fires gentle pollen sparks; casts faint glimmer revealing path in dark corridors.
weapons.runic_skill: Spark Flash: Magic flare repelling small creepy-crawlies within 1 tile.
weapons.materials_needed: 12 Oak Wood + 2 Quartz + 220 Gold at Boris's Forge

weapons.name: Firefly Storm Lantern
weapons.description: Ranged magical focus that fires volleys of jade sparks, repelling hostile creatures while dispelling miasma and illuminating dark tunnels.
weapons.upgrade_path: Upgrades at Boris's Forge: Iron → Obsidian
weapons.special_effect: Knocks back monsters, illuminates deep shafts, and parts thick mist.
weapons.runic_skill: Luminescent Aura: Releases orbiting fireflies creating a radiant barrier damaging contacts.
weapons.materials_needed: 6 Iron Bars + 1 Firefly Essence + 2 Quartz + 2,200 Gold at Boris's Forge

weapons.name: Volcanic Magma Rod
weapons.description: Magical rod crowned with a blazing garnet atop obsidian spire; launches explosive molten spheres melting frost creatures.
weapons.upgrade_path: Upgrades at Boris's Forge: Obsidian → Starlight Core
weapons.special_effect: Launches explosive molten spheres melting frost creatures and cave ice.
weapons.runic_skill: Ring of Fire: Summons circular fire barrier searing and deterring approaching foes for 6s.
weapons.materials_needed: 8 Obsidian + 2 Rubies + 8,500 Gold at Boris's Forge

weapons.name: Primordial Starlight Staff
weapons.description: Mythic focus channeling pure cosmic starlight; purifies Star Blight corruption and dispels the deepest subterranean shadows.
weapons.upgrade_path: Pinnacle Tier: Forged at Boris's Forge with a Starlight Core
weapons.special_effect: Channels pure cosmic starlight; purifies Star Blight corruption and dispels deep shadows.
weapons.runic_skill: Supernova: Condenses a celestial singularity detonating in a screen-clearing cosmic burst.
weapons.materials_needed: 1 Starlight Core + 3 Sapphires + 3 Diamonds + 26,000 Gold at Boris's Forge
